title: Berhill, Killiney Road, Dalkey, Co. Dublin, A96 XP66
seoTitle: Berhill, Killiney Road, Dalkey, Co. Dublin, A96 XP66
description:
Positioned on the prestigious Killiney Road, close to the entrance of Ballinclea Heights, Berhill is an impressive four-bedroom mid-terraced family home occupying a magnificent site with substantial front and rear gardens. Offering approximately 165 sq.m (1,776 sq.ft) of well-proportioned accommodation, this exceptional residence combines generous living spaces with outstanding potential for future enhancement and extension.

The interior of Berhill has been thoughtfully modernised and reconfigured to create a bright, contemporary home perfectly suited to modern family life. A welcoming reception hall sets the tone, featuring stylish timber-effect flooring, a digital security alarm system and useful understairs storage. To the front of the property, a beautifully presented sitting room enjoys an attractive solid fuel limestone fireplace with polished granite hearth, creating a warm and inviting space for relaxation. The former garage has been expertly converted into a versatile playroom, complete with bespoke blackboard wall, recessed LED lighting and glazed folding doors, offering an ideal family room, home office or children's entertainment space.

The true heart of the home is the impressive open-plan kitchen, dining and family room spanning the rear of the property. Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, this stunning space features a large marble-topped island, bespoke two-tone Shaker-style cabinetry, Rangemaster range cooker, American-style fridge freezer and integrated appliances. Double folding glazed doors open directly onto the rear patio and gardens, flooding the room with natural light while seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living. A feature fireplace with gas coal-effect fire, together with fitted shelving and cabinetry, adds warmth and character to this exceptional family space. A practical utility room, discreetly positioned off the kitchen, provides excellent additional storage and laundry facilities.

Upstairs, the accommodation comprises four well-proportioned bedrooms. The principal guest suite enjoys a private ensuite shower room, while the remaining bedrooms offer comfortable and flexible accommodation for growing families. A beautifully appointed family bathroom features both a bath and separate walk-in shower, complemented by contemporary sanitary ware, an illuminated mirror and chrome heated towel rail. Throughout the home, quality finishes, excellent natural light and carefully considered design combine to create a residence of exceptional comfort and style.

Outside, the private rear garden provides a wonderful sanctuary, completely enclosed and not overlooked. Framed by mature trees, hedging and colourful planting, the garden is predominantly laid in lawn and features an attractive sandstone patio, providing the perfect setting for outdoor dining, entertaining and family enjoyment. It measures approximately 21m (69 ft) in length. To the front, gated gravelled parking accommodates several vehicles and benefits from an EV charging point, further enhancing the practicality of this outstanding family home.

Reception Hall 4.2m x 2m. With timber effect floor, Phonewatch digital security alarm and understairs storage.

Downstairs WC Comprising WC, wash hand basin set in vanity unit, fitted mirrors either side , extractor fan.

Kitchen/Family/Dining Area 5.7m x 7.3m. Through double folding glazed door, open plan,  timber effect floor, LED recessed lighting, centre island unit with pull out bin and polished marble worktop, marble splashback, marble upstands, two tone (grey blue and white) Shaker style press units, a Rangemaster five-ring gas hob with double oven with Rangemaster extractor over, Samsung American style fridge freezer, Hisense integrated dishwasher, one and a half bowel sink unit set in with drainer to the side and Quooker tap, cupboards, drawers, saucepan drawers, double folding double glazed doors opening out onto rear garden. Opposite the kitchen there is a fireplace with a glazed gas coal effect fire with fitted shelving and cupboards on either side of the chimney breast.

Utility Room 0.9m x 5.2m. With timber effect floor, fuseboard, comms, plumbed for washing machine and tumble dryer, built in box shelving, wash hand basin and extractor fan.

Sitting Room 4.2m x 3.4m. Located to the front with timber effect floor, picture overlooking the front, attractive open solid fuel burning limestone fireplace with raised polished granite hearth and inset, television point and door back out to reception hall.
